# Slower widget responses, no follow-up promised

We are seeing slower first responses on tickets raised through the in-app widget,
and some reached the wrong team before being picked up. If you raised a widget
ticket in the last two weeks and waited longer than usual for a first reply, this
is why.

We have found the cause. Our routing rules send widget tickets to the wrong queue,
and agents have been correcting that by hand.

We do not have a restoration estimate. Agents are re-routing affected tickets
manually, so nothing is sitting unattended.
